### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. Pelizaeus-Merzbacher spectrum disorder  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.778)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:9086)

**Proposed mechanism:** PLP1 (HGNC:9086) —DISRUPTS→ Abnormal myelination (HP:0003470); PLP1 (HGNC:9086) —DISRUPTS→ Spasticity (HP:0002360); PLP1 (HGNC:9086) —DISRUPTS→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); PLP1 (HGNC:9086) —DISRUPTS→ Delayed gross motor development (HP:0001263). Mutations in PLP1 lead to abnormal myelination, which underlies the shared phenotypes of spasticity, intellectual disability, and delayed motor development seen in both disorders.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of distinct causal genes for each disease in independent cohorts, or demonstration that mutations in PLP1 consistently lead to a completely different set of phenotypes in one disease compared to the other. _(variant: Common variants (AF > 0.01) in PLP1 in gnomAD.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared genetic basis in PLP1 allows for the investigation of common therapeutic strategies targeting myelin development and maintenance for both Pelizaeus-Merzbacher spectrum disorder and Spastic paraplegia 50.
